title: Rajmala (The Royal Chronicle of the Kings of Tripura)
author: Kailash Chandra Singha & Royal Court Historians
description: The monumental dynastic chronicle of the Manikya Dynasty of Tripura, documenting over 180 kings, ancient wars, temple consecrations, and tribal customs.
